main_body: dead weeping tree with hanging branches and trunk
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat front silhouette: vertical brown strands hang from the top (rows 0-35) with no overhead crown or top-lit upper volume, and the trunk sits on a flat 2px horizontal bar base (rows 53-55) rather than roots spreading in 3/4 space.
